summary: Describe externally observable behavior, constraints, and acceptance criteria for a bounded change.

inputs.name: outcome-brief
inputs.description: Agreed outcome, scope, constraints, and unresolved decisions.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Current behavior and relevant system constraints.

inputs.name: privacy-assessment
inputs.description: Current privacy assessment evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

completion_checks: Every in-scope outcome has observable acceptance criteria.
Failure, compatibility, and operational requirements are addressed where applicable.
Open decisions and non-goals are explicit.
failure_modes: A material scope or behavior decision is unresolved: blocked.
Source artifacts disagree without an established priority: inconclusive.
